seoTitle: Free CSV Viewer - Sort & Filter CSV Online
metaDescription: Free online CSV viewer. Open or paste a CSV file and browse it as a sortable, filterable table with auto-detected delimiter. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Open a CSV file or paste text and see it as a table. Click a header to sort, type in the filter box to narrow rows, and choose the delimiter if auto-detection guesses wrong.
why:
Opening a CSV in a spreadsheet can change it: leading zeros vanish, long numbers turn into scientific notation and dates get reinterpreted. Sometimes you just want to look at the file, find a row, or check that an export has the columns you expect.

This viewer shows the data exactly as it is in the file. Click a column header to sort, with numbers sorted as numbers, and use the filter box to keep only rows that contain your text in any column. A row count tells you how many rows match. You can open a file from disk or paste text. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded, which makes it safe for exports that contain personal or commercial data.
howTo: Open a CSV file with the file picker, or paste text into the box.
Check the delimiter and change it if the columns look wrong.
Click a column header to sort, and click again to reverse the order.
Type in the filter box to show only rows containing that text.

faq.a: No. The file is read by your browser and rendered locally. Nothing is sent to a server, so exports with personal data can be inspected safely.
Click a header to sort by that column. If both values are numbers they are compared numerically, otherwise as text with natural ordering. Click again to switch between ascending and descending.

faq.q: How big a file can it show?
faq.a: It builds a normal HTML table, so files with tens of thousands of rows work but may feel slow. For very large files, filter first or split the file before viewing.

faq.q: Can I edit or save changes?
faq.a: No, it is a viewer. To convert the data use CSV to JSON or the other converters, or edit the text in the box and watch the table update.
